starting_state: Freshly mixed Fehling A/B and a separate reducing-sugar aliquot already combined in one tube, suspended in a heated water bath. No claimed concentration, temperature or reacted endpoint.
scope: Short ongoing water-bath heating excerpt after reagent/sample preparation. Not a full heating interval or a fabricated positive response; source also distinguishes negative sucrose before hydrolysis.

clips.name: fehling_heating_excerpt
clips.target_object: The blue reaction mixture in the inner test tube, distinct from the clear external water bath.
clips.action: Continue steady gentle water-bath heating of the existing prepared Fehling test mixture; keep the clamped inner tube and the clear outer bath separate.
clips.state_before: Blue reaction mixture in the inner tube; clear bath outside it; no orange-red precipitate yet.
clips.state_after: Only the inner reducing-sugar test mixture may gradually develop the source's orange-red precipitate as heating progresses; the outer bath stays clear. Do not force completion of a long heating period or colour the external bath.
